name: Learning Commons
description: Connect Learning Commons to Claude to align with all 50 states’ academic standards, break them into granular learning components, and trace learning progressions. Generate more precise, standards-aligned instructional content that supports coherent learning and reflects educational best practices and learning science.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Learning Commons to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Learning Commons to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://kg.mcp.learningcommons.org/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Learning Commons MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Learning Commons scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Learning Commons MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Learning Commons provides these MCP tools: find_learning_components_from_standard, find_standards_progression_from_standard, and find_standard_statement.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Learning Commons?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Learning Commons in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.

_published_faq.name: Does Learning Commons MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Learning Commons does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Learning Commons failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Learning Commons scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Learning Commons is developed by Learning Commons. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
